key_insight: Ambient SFT uses imperfect model predictions to expand fine-tuning datasets, aiming to learn more from limited supervised data without losing knowledge of rare examples.
problem_solved: Supervised fine-tuning datasets are much smaller than pre-training datasets, making models prone to overfitting and forgetting rare patterns in the original data distribution.
method: Introduce Ambient SFT, a framework that augments supervised fine-tuning data using imperfect predictions.
Use temperature matching as the central mechanism indicated by the title; the provided abstract is incomplete and does not explain its implementation.
Aim to preserve coverage of rare patterns while adapting the model with limited supervised data.
impact: The approach could make supervised fine-tuning more data-efficient while reducing overfitting and forgetting. The provided excerpt does not include experimental results or quantified gains.
